colour.scope: Controlled cropped pre-remod lobe-sum fixture, CPU previous EMA provided; not a full production game replay.
colour.history_scope: CPU chronological warmup frames 0..62; actual GPU comparison executed frame63 only. Not a 64-frame GPU replay.
colour.target_domain: input_diffuse RGB + input_specular RGB; native physical units; no exact game remod factor or Skip.
colour.output_domain: raw_rr_diffuse RGB + raw_rr_specular RGB; controlled pre-remod lobe sum, not final game display.
colour.motion_contract: CPU uses original captured UV times original render size before box. Integer-load GPU Stats may use Size.xy=original render, Size.zw=ROI quarter; Apply Size.xy=ROI. ROI-rescaled motion is provided only as an alternative, with extra quantization.
colour.precision_caveat: Fixture input_rgb/rr_rgb are RTZ R16-expanded float32. Original expected_soft2 was made using pre-UAV float32 RR chroma for JBU weights, then RTZ for multiplication; those pre-UAV low bits are absent here. Stats/history/gain/bilinear are separately compared. Do not claim exact expected_soft2 reproduction solely from rounded rr_rgb.
colour.sampler_caveat: Original numpy bilinear is continuous. On the audited GPU, history interpolation fraction quantization changes the hard 2% depth validity decision in 9/4096 cells. A 1/256 fraction model matched those decisions; it is not enabled in this preserved CPU export.

glass.alignment_contract: reference-depth camera-only reprojection, P00/P11 convention, bilinear source sampling; no source-depth occlusion or dynamic-motion compensation
glass.geometry_provenance: original_* arrays are UNWARPED source-frame crop values in exact stored dtype; aligned eligibility/masks are separate booleans
glass.raw_role: aligned captured raw RR specular RGB float32; not native pre-provider input
glass.selected_role: aligned captured old NZR specular RGB stored as uint32 XOR against raw bits
glass.reference_warning: Game capture has NO ground truth. Captured selected is OLD NZR output, not a reference for a new algorithm.
